-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_iam_role" "this" {
  name               = "r"
  path               = var.role_path
  assume_role_policy = "{}"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

variable "role_path" {
  type    = string
  default = "/"
}
